title: security: rbac v2 + audit logging hardening for KMS region pinning and residency enforcement
author: Elena Park
release_notes: Hardening: RBAC v2 policy validations for KMS region pinning; audit logging expanded to capture KMS key usage and region enforcement decisions; migration helper for existing policies; no user-facing API changes.
body: Motivation: Enforce stricter KMS region residency and improve auditing for RBAC v2 to meet compliance requirements for regulated customers. This PR introduces policy-level enforcement for KMS region pinning, expands audit events to record key resolution and region decisions, and hardens validation in the RBAC v2 policy engine to reject mismatched residency rules. Changes include a migration helper to transform existing policy configs, schema bumps for policy v2, end-to-end tests, and docs updates. Checklist: 1) RBAC v2 validation added and unit tested; 2) Audit events for KMS operations and region_pin decisions; 3) Migration script + dry-run mode; 4) Integration tests against k8s private installer and Private deployment; 5) Docs and release notes. Impact: default behavior is additive: audit events enabled by default, enforcement opt-in via org-level flag (security.residency.enforce=true) until rollout. Rollout plan: staged feature flag rollout with canary on internal accounts, monitoring dashboard and regression alerts added to Console. Backwards compatibility: migration helper will emit warnings; operators can run dry-run to preview rejections. Testing: unit tests, integration suite in perf-canary, and manual verification with sample policies. Related: references ENG-4821, SEC-210, SUP-678.

d3a9e7b: kms: record key resolution and region_pin decision in audit event payload

e2f5d4a: tests: add unit and integration tests for residency enforcement
f9b1c3d: docs: update admin guide and release notes
review_comments: Marcus Lee: Please add a migration dry-run and a clear rollback path. Also call out any DB schema changes - we should avoid online migrations where possible.

Elena Park: Added dry-run mode to the migration helper and documented rollback steps in the PR body. No DB schema changes required; policy documents stored as JSON blobs are transformed in-place with versioned metadata.
Priya Nair: Audit event volume might spike when enabling default audit for KMS. Can we add sampling or a cardinality guard on noisy fields?

Elena Park: Added a cardinality guard to redact high-cardinality client metadata by default and added observability counters to monitor audit event rate. We will phase in sampling if telemetry shows sustained spikes.
Jordan Kim: Tests look good. Suggest expanding e2e to include a Private deployment with VPC KMS emulator (we can reuse perf-canary job).

Elena Park: Added an integration test that runs in perf-canary against the KMS emulator and updated CI matrix to include the smoke scenario for Private installer in a follow-up job to keep CI time bounded.
